what_this_document_is: a forward-recorded supersession. It states, per arm, which P2 conclusions stand and which are withdrawn.

what_this_document_is_not.no_commit_rewriting: no commit is amended, rebased or rewritten. Supersession is recorded FORWARD. The P2 registration, its results JSON, its prediction parquets and its feature artifact are left exactly as they were.
what_this_document_is_not.no_repair_and_rerun: no arm is repaired and re-run in this wave. Dropping a duplicated column, rebuilding a leaking column or matching an intercept AFTER results are visible is a post-result design change. Every repair named here must be registered as a NEW frozen challenger in a later wave.
what_this_document_is_not.registry_not_modified: arm_registry.jsonl is NOT modified by this document. Proposed records are staged in PROPOSED_REGISTRY_RECORDS.jsonl for the coordinator, who is the single writer.
what_this_document_is_not.artifacts_untouched: Arm D, the canonical exposure artifact, the canonical turnover target and feature_gate.py are untouched.

A.note: control arm, carries no P2 feature; unchanged by this record

D.note: not a P2 arm. Not altered, not retuned, not re-adjudicated here.

G.reason: the leaking feature effect exceeds the reported gain

arms_E_and_I.defect: algebraic non-identifiability. Group 1 registered BOTH proj_minutes_share AND proj_off_poss_share. Under the v1 minutes-to-possession mapping projected possessions are exactly pace * minutes / 40, so the two are THE SAME COLUMN.

measured_rank.method: feature_gate.design_rank_report at commit 0397fbd, on the standardised complete-case design

arms_E_and_I.consequence: arms E and I carry a rank-deficient design on top of an offset that already contains log(exposure). Their fitted predictions diverge; the reported deviance and team MAE are NOT scientific results and must not be cited, compared, ranked or plotted.

measured_divergence.reading: the divergence is concentrated: the median row is ordinary and the peak row is ~4.85e8

arms_E_and_I.solver_note: a damped IRLS with step-halving was added and the fit CONVERGES. The explosion is the collinear design, not optimiser divergence.
arms_E_and_I.what_remains_valid: nothing from E or I. A rank-deficient design's coefficients are a property of the ridge penalty, not of the data, so there is no partial result to salvage.
arms_E_and_I.relationship_to_the_existing_erratum: arm_registry.jsonl already carries p2__erratum_arms_E_and_I_invalid_collinear_registration. This record CONFIRMS and EXTENDS it with the measured rank deficiency and the second dependency in arm I. It does not contradict or replace it.

arm_F_operational.defect: missingness encoded did_appear. trailing_minutes_share, trailing_rotation_rank, role_change and offensive_involvement_proxy were built from the REALISED box score and left-merged onto the Tier A candidate universe, so their null mask is an exact post-cutoff appearance indicator.
arm_F_operational.consequence: any fillna launders the outcome into the design. P2's operational fit mean-imputes those nulls inside the fold, which encodes a post-cutoff appearance oracle into the design matrix. The P2 registration's own feature boundary forbids post-cutoff availability, so arm F's operational result violates the arm's declared boundary.
arm_F_operational.why_the_value_based_checks_missed_it: value-based leakage checks only ever see the non-null subset. Only a null-mask-versus-outcome test catches this. That test now exists in feature_gate.py as missingness_encodes_outcome (added at 42af2cd); it did not exist when P2 was fitted.
arm_F_operational.what_this_record_does_NOT_do: it makes no finding that clears the INTRINSIC track. The intrinsic frame is realised-participant rows only and carries no did_appear column; its 894 nulls on every P2-merged feature arise from left-merge non-matches, not from the appearance mask. The intrinsic track is neither invalidated nor independently re-validated here.
arm_F_operational.direction_note: the DIRECTION of the P2 F conclusion -- that the registered prior-role formulation added no stable incremental value -- is not established by arm F. Any such claim must cite clean evidence, not this arm.

arm_G_published_player_level_improvement.scope_of_the_finding: the PLAYER-LEVEL improvement claim only. The arithmetic in TURNOVER_P2_RESULTS.json is correct; it is the ATTRIBUTION that fails.
arm_G_published_player_level_improvement.defect: offensive_involvement_proxy carries the same exact did_appear null mask (27,351 non-null / 8,278 null, zero off-diagonal), and the leaking feature effect exceeds the reported gain.

the_decisive_comparison.verdict: the leaking feature effect exceeds the reported gain by roughly a factor of sixteen

provenance_of_the_leak_measurement.construction: the same one-feature arm refitted through an identical pipeline, once on the canonical LEAKING column and once on a cutoff-valid rebuild, with identical training rows
provenance_of_the_leak_measurement.ws3_pipeline_note: both variants were refitted on the OPERATIONAL track walk-forward (P2 trained on the intrinsic frame), so absolute levels need not reproduce P2. The leaking-vs-clean CONTRAST is the measurement.

independent_corroboration_computed_at_th.method: decompose the published D-minus-G operational player deviance by appearance status
independent_corroboration_computed_at_th.reading: the entire published gain originates on the 8,278 rows whose feature value is an imputation determined by the outcome-encoding null mask. On the 27,351 rows where the feature is actually observed, arm G is WORSE than arm D.

arm_G_published_player_level_improvement.consequence: the reported player-level improvement cannot be attributed to the basketball content of the involvement proxy. Arm G may not be cited as evidence that offensive involvement adds player-level turnover-rate information.
arm_G_published_player_level_improvement.what_is_NOT_claimed: this record does not claim the involvement proxy is worthless. It claims that P2 arm G does not establish its value. Per player_event_failure_analysis_policy_v1, a failed registered formulation is not a finding about the underlying basketball information.

what_is_not_withdrawn.team_level_result: the G-versus-D operational team-level LOSS (-0.005055505634143039, ci90 [-0.009645679763657248, -0.0006143227264758999]) is a separately reproduced phenomenon and is not withdrawn by this record.
what_is_not_withdrawn.reproduced_by: discovery_wave_1/ws6 (branch tip 5ef1f25) reproduces the reference involvement coefficient beta = 0.024297, z = 4.8938.

arm_G_published_player_level_improvement.what_is_withdrawn: the published arm G PLAYER-LEVEL improvement claim and every downstream statement resting on it.

original_comparison_against_arm_D.consequence: a comparison whose unmatched intercept term is worth about +0.0033 operational team MAE cannot adjudicate effects of this size in EITHER direction. The original arm H challenger-versus-D conclusion is withdrawn as an ADJUDICATION, not as arithmetic.
what_remains_valid: the arm H FEATURE is clean and may be reused without missingness remediation
the arm H numbers are arithmetically correct and may be quoted as descriptive statistics

original_comparison_against_arm_D.what_is_required_before_re_adjudication: a re-run against an intercept-matched incumbent, registered as a NEW frozen challenger in a later wave. Not a re-analysis of the existing fit.
original_comparison_against_arm_D.related_work: the general form of this defect is the subject of comparison_gate.py, integrity workstream A. This record neither specifies nor assumes that module's interface.

clean_discovery_results_are_separate_evi.rule: the clean WS5 and WS6 discovery results are SEPARATE EVIDENCE and MUST NOT be backfilled into the original P2 registration. P2 stands SUPERSEDED AS RUN. It is not retroactively repaired.

ws5_opportunity_proxies.status: DISCOVERY, historical development evidence only; nothing promotable
ws5_opportunity_proxies.verdict: SPLIT. As rate predictors and as interaction variables all six clean opportunity proxies FAIL against K0. As player-allocation weights five of six deliver a small, season-stable player-level gain over K0 at zero team-level cost (x1 allocation weight: +0.00175 vs K0 player, ci90 [0.0015, 0.00198]). The ledger's expected direction -- that play-ending involvement beats FGA share -- is FALSIFIED (r = 0.994, identical performance in every role).

ws6_mechanism_decomposition.status: DISCOVERY ONLY -- development evidence; nothing promoted, nothing registered

ws3_total_plus_allocation.note: ws3 supplies the leaking-versus-clean measurement quoted under arm G. That measurement is cited here as ws3's finding, on ws3's evidence, at ws3's commit. It is not imported into the P2 registration.

why_separate: DIFFERENT LANE. P2 is a registered promotion-style comparison against a frozen incumbent. ws3, ws5 and ws6 are DISCOVERY, on development folds, explicitly non-promotable.
DIFFERENT INPUTS. ws3 and ws5 rebuilt the leaking columns. Their numbers are measured on inputs the P2 registration never used.

DIFFERENT REGISTRATION STATUS. None of them was registered before execution as a P2 challenger. Inserting their results into P2 would convert post-hoc discovery into pre-registered confirmation -- the exact substitution the program's registration discipline exists to prevent.

BACKFILLING WOULD LAUNDER A NULL. P2's honest outcome is that no registered role feature added stable value, with several arms invalid. Grafting a clean discovery result onto that record would convert a null into an apparent success that no pre-registered test produced.
clean_discovery_results_are_separate_evi.where_to_cite_them_from: their own workstream records, at their own commits, under their own DISCOVERY status.

gate_invocation_contract.clause: feature audits must run separately on EVERY chronological training fold and again on the final assembled design. A pooled audit cannot establish that every training fold is identified.
gate_invocation_contract.motivating_case: ws3 stage-2 2022 training fold: proj_off_poss_share std 7.80108356964482e-09 and p_active std 5.13611574504531e-17, while the POOLED audit over the same 35,629 rows passed both columns with zero findings. |X.gamma| reached 6.9e4 and the within-team softmax saturated to exact 0/1 shares. The optimiser converged in five Newton iterations in every fold.
gate_invocation_contract.retrospective_note: had the contract and the current gate been in force at P2, arms E and I would have been blocked pre-fit on near_collinear and rank_deficient, and arms F and G on missingness_encodes_outcome. This is an observation about invocation timing, NOT a licence to repair and re-run inside the P2 wave.
